verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Deel's MCP server exposes payroll data to agents, and a separate API sandbox exists for testing. Neither is a documented payroll-run preview (dry-run) endpoint, anomaly surfacing, or a pre-approval review step for a payroll run. Reading payroll data is a developer building block, and sandbox isolation is not a dry-run of a real payroll, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
